evals.name: code-punctuation-tokenizer
evals.prompt: /solve top_words("Hello, world! Hello.") gives [('hello,', 1), ('world!', 1), ('hello.', 1)] instead of [('hello', 2), ('world', 1)]
evals.expected_output: CODE mode detected; failing repro test written and shown; 3 solvers in separate worktrees with distinct angles; independent verification of each diff; fresh judge picks a winner; report table; asks before applying; worktrees and solve/* branches removed.

evals.name: arch-todo-storage-multiuser
evals.prompt: /solve The todo CLI rewrites the whole ~/.todo.json on every add/complete; with ~50k tasks each command takes about a second. We also want several users on the same machine to share one task list without clobbering each other's writes. How should we restructure the storage layer?
evals.expected_output: ARCH mode detected; requirements with HARD/SOFT constraints and weighted criteria shown for approval; 3 proposals with Mermaid diagrams, migration paths, spikes measuring performance/concurrency; cross-critique round; fresh judge scores against weights; ADR written to docs/decisions/; offer of /solve --mode code implementation steps; worktrees cleaned up.
